page.layout: One page of text, centred dedication. Large display headings at the top, a dedicatory paragraph below, and the signature "C. M. de Veil." at lower right. No margin notes. Mirrored show-through from the reverse side runs through the headings and is left out.

main_text.head: ILLVSTRISSIMO [?] PROPAGATORI,
FORTISSIMO SUPERSTITIONUM & HÆRESEON COMPVGNATORI,
APOSTOLICI MINISTERII FIDELISSIMO DISPENSATORI,
AMANTISSIMO PAUPERUM PARENTI,
ECCLESIARUM EVANGELICARUM QUANTUMVIS DISTANTIUM FAUTORI PRÆSENTISSIMO,
A CONSILIIS SANCTIORIBUS PROFANA PAPISMI NOVITATE AD SANCTAM ET ANTIQUAM RELIGIONIS CATHOLICÆ PURITATEM SYNCERE CONVERSORUM CERTISSIMO PRÆSIDIO,
PATRONO SUO COLENDISSIMO,
main_text.p: Hoc qualecunque cùm ingenij & studij, tum animi grati monumentum dicat, vovet, ac consecrat observantissimus in Christo filius, & omnium, qui vivunt, hominum multò maximè addictus, deditus, obstrictus,

page.notes: Heavy show-through of the reverse side in the headings (mirrored lines such as "CHRISTO PATRI ET DOMINO", "ECCLESIÆ", "COMPLIANT" fragments) is not transcribed. The first line "ILLVSTRISSIMO" and the word after "COMPIU" in the second heading are partly obscured; "COMPVGNATORI" is a best reading. The signature is in script and is given as printed.
